items.title: Onboarding

items.name: app-profile-settings
items.title: Profile & Settings
items.description: An account screen: avatar header with membership badge and stat row, plus grouped setting rows with toggles, values and a destructive action.

items.name: site-landing
items.title: Landing Page
items.description: A marketing home: nav bar, announcement pill, large hero with dual calls to action, logo social proof, and a three-column feature row.

items.name: site-pricing
items.title: Pricing Page
items.description: Three pricing tiers with a monthly/yearly toggle, a highlighted popular plan, checked feature lists, and an FAQ strip.

items.name: site-dashboard
items.title: Dashboard
items.description: A product app shell: navigation sidebar with account footer, stat tiles with trends, a bar chart with range toggle, and a status table.

items.name: site-docs
items.title: Documentation
items.description: A three-column docs layout: search bar with shortcut, grouped nav, article with breadcrumb, code block, callout and options table, plus an on-this-page rail.

items.name: site-auth
items.title: Sign In
items.description: A split authentication page: social and credential sign-in with remember-me on one side, a dark testimonial panel with stats on the other.

items.name: site-agents
items.title: Agents Landing
items.description: A warm-toned product landing page: sticky nav with dropdown affordances, breadcrumb strip, split hero with a node-graph illustration, and a partner logo wall.

items.name: site-research
items.title: Research Home
items.description: A publication home page: translucent nav, centred prompt hero with quick-action pills, a bento lead story and a recent-news row. Thumbnails are real photos.

items.name: site-fintech-hero
items.title: Fintech Hero
items.description: A full-bleed photo backdrop with a floating pill nav and a footer-anchored headline — the composition that pairs a bold claim with feature chips below the fold.

items.name: section-hero
items.title: Hero
items.description: A centred marketing hero: announcement pill, large headline, supporting copy, dual calls to action, and avatar social proof.

items.name: section-features
items.title: Features
items.description: A six-item feature grid with icon tiles, an eyebrow label and a centred section heading.

items.name: section-bento
items.title: Bento Grid
items.description: A mixed-size feature grid: one large panel with a bar chart, three supporting tiles, and a wide closing tile.

items.name: section-pricing
items.title: Pricing
items.description: Three pricing tiers with a working monthly/yearly toggle that swaps the price, a highlighted popular plan, and checked feature lists.

items.name: section-testimonials
items.title: Testimonials
items.description: A working quote slider: three testimonials switched by clickable dot navigation, no JavaScript.

items.name: section-faq
items.title: FAQ
items.description: A five-question accordion built on native details/summary, with a rotating plus icon and a contact line.

items.name: section-cta
items.title: CTA
items.description: A dark closing call-to-action banner with decorative gradients and dual actions.

items.name: section-stats
items.title: Stats
items.description: A four-up metric row on a dark band, with a heading and supporting line.

items.name: section-logo-cloud
items.title: Logo Cloud
items.description: A compact social-proof band: an eyebrow label above a row of muted customer wordmarks.

items.name: section-team
items.title: Team
items.description: A four-up team grid: photo avatar, name and role, with a heading and supporting line above.

items.name: section-newsletter
items.title: Newsletter
items.description: A real email subscribe form with native required validation, an icon tile and a supporting line.

items.name: section-footer
items.title: Footer
items.description: A five-column footer: brand blurb, four link groups, and a legal row with social icons.

items.name: section-customer-stories
items.title: Customer Stories
items.description: A two-column case-study grid pairing a square brand-locked thumbnail with a headline, summary and inline link. Thumbnails are real photos.

items.name: section-plan-picker
items.title: Plan Picker
items.description: Credit-based pricing tiers with a per-month allowance box, indented model lists, and a highlighted plan wrapped in a dark shell with an amber call to action.

items.name: section-service-grid
items.title: Service Grid
items.description: A 2×2 directory of service categories, each a pastel panel with tag pills and an Explore footer, above a filter header with a live status dot.

items.name: section-lead-form
items.title: Lead Gen Form
items.description: A long-form informational page — savings, benefits and contractor copy — ending in a multi-fieldset request form with a real radio-scale question. Auto-height, so nothing is clipped.

items.name: agent-chat
items.title: Agent Chat
items.description: A complete conversation shell: header with agent status, scrollable thread with an inline tool call, and a composer.

items.name: message-list
items.title: Message List
items.description: A conversation thread with user bubbles, assistant turns, hover actions, and a streaming turn with a caret.

items.name: input-bar
items.title: Input Bar
items.description: The composer: auto-height textarea, attachment and tools controls, model readout, dictation, and a send button.

items.name: suggestions
items.title: Suggestions
items.description: Prompt starters in two shapes: a wrapping chip row and a stacked list with icons and descriptions.

items.name: model-picker
items.title: Model Picker
items.description: A model selector trigger plus the open menu: options with descriptions, a selected check, and a settings row.

items.name: mode-selector
items.title: Mode Selector
items.description: Segmented controls for switching agent modes — a full-width pill group and a compact bordered variant.

items.name: user-message
items.title: User Message
items.description: The sent turn: a plain bubble and a richer variant with an attached file, timestamp, and edit/copy actions.

items.name: markdown
items.title: Markdown
items.description: Typography for rendered agent output: headings, lists, inline code, a titled code block, blockquote, table, and links.

items.name: send-button
items.title: Send Button
items.description: Send affordance in four states: idle, disabled, generating (stop), and a labelled variant with a keyboard hint.

items.name: attachment-button
items.title: Attachment Button
items.description: Attachment triggers (plus and paperclip) with the open source menu: file, image, repo, and clipboard.

items.name: file-attachment
items.title: File Attachment
items.description: Attached files as removable chips, an uploading card with a progress bar, and a failed card with a retry action.

items.name: text-shimmer
items.title: Text Shimmer
items.description: A shimmering status label for pending work, plus a pulsing skeleton. Ships one scoped style block for the keyframes.

items.name: spiral-loader
items.title: Spiral Loader
items.description: A masked conic-gradient spinner in three sizes, a bordered ring variant, and an inline running-status row.

items.name: bash-tool
items.title: Bash Tool
items.description: Terminal tool calls: command header, scrollable output, exit-status pill, duration footer, and a failed variant.

items.name: edit-tool
items.title: Edit Tool
items.description: A file-edit tool call rendered as a diff: path header with +/− counts, gutter line numbers, and apply actions.

items.name: search-tool
items.title: Search Tool
items.description: Grep-style results grouped by file, with line gutters, highlighted matches, and a search summary footer.

items.name: todo-tool
items.title: Todo Tool
items.description: The agent's task list: completed items struck through, an in-progress row with a spinner, pending rows, and a progress bar.

items.name: plan-tool
items.title: Plan Tool
items.description: A proposed plan awaiting approval: numbered steps with affected files, a status pill, and approve/edit actions.

items.name: tool-group
items.title: Tool Group
items.description: A collapsible run of tool calls: summary header with stacked icons and timing, collapsed, expanded, and running children.

items.name: ide-composer
items.title: IDE Composer
items.description: A dark, IDE-embedded prompt bar: session placeholder with a blinking caret, mode toggle row, and a bottom Local/Remote action strip. Always dark, like the editor panel it depicts.

items.name: chat-welcome
items.title: Chat Welcome
items.description: The empty-state screen before any messages exist: a centred greeting above a rounded composer with a teal send button and a scroll-to-bottom affordance.

items.name: button
items.title: Button
items.description: Primary, secondary, ghost, destructive and link buttons across four sizes, with loading, disabled and icon states.

items.name: badge
items.title: Badge
items.description: Status pills in seven tones plus dot, counter, removable-tag and small label variants.

items.name: card
items.title: Card
items.description: A surface in three shapes: header/body/footer card, stat card with a bar sparkline, and a clickable link card.

items.name: input
items.title: Input
items.description: Form fields: labelled input with hint, search with shortcut, prefixed input, invalid state, textarea and disabled.

items.name: alert
items.title: Alert
items.description: Neutral, success, warning and error alerts with icons and actions, plus a solid inline announcement banner.

items.name: tabs
items.title: Tabs
items.description: Three tab patterns — underline with a count badge, pill group, and vertical tabs beside a panel.

items.name: avatar
items.title: Avatar
items.description: Photo avatars in four sizes and several tones, with a presence dot, initials and icon fallback states, overlap stack and account row.

items.name: empty-state
items.title: Empty State
items.description: A dashed placeholder with icon, copy and actions, plus a compact no-results row for search.

items.name: radio-card-group
items.title: Radio Card Group
items.description: Selectable plan cards backed by native radio inputs — checked, hover and disabled states are driven entirely by CSS, so selection works without JavaScript.

items.name: prompt-composer
items.title: Prompt Composer
items.description: A rounded message box with an inline toolbar — attachment, agent and model pickers on the left, send on the right. The shell lights up on focus-within.

items.name: auth-card
items.title: Auth Card
items.description: A sign-in panel with crosshair corner marks and bleeding hairlines — email and password fields, a primary action, and GitHub / Google providers.

items.name: badge-pill
items.title: Badge Pill
items.description: shadcn-style semantic badge variants — default, secondary, outline and destructive — for labelling status inside a larger component.

items.name: login-glass
items.title: Login Glass
items.description: A translucent, glassmorphic auth card floating over two soft drifting blobs — email, password and a full-width primary action.
